objective: Evaluate E[C] = E[S] + E[C-S] for the fixed H4 S0 rounds under one law, one full Hadamard wrapper with measurement and one compiler profile

fixed_conditions.system: Linear H4, 1.00 Angstrom, STO-3G, saved tol-only DF10, saved H/state/snapshot, saved fragment order
fixed_conditions.split: PR L_D=1, S2, delta_PF=0.1, K=2, h=0.1, M=12, symmetric_directional control, P=0
fixed_conditions.paired_acquisition_source: C1 r_price_phase1_science.Backend.price_requests (1a87e5331b52a49732b7db9d49d28f1fe6d9c9a7): S by Accounting and C by compose -> build_native_hadamard_wrapper(include_measurement=True) -> transpile_and_measure_cost on the same requests
fixed_conditions.structural_expectation_source: C h4_structural_kernel K1 (7aca17fe..., currently NOT executed; K0 PASS required)

stages.purpose: Confirm or refute the SOURCE-level lowering difference: compiled RZZGate(2theta).control(1) via generic add_control (CCX.CRZ.CCX) versus the structural counter's crzz (CX.CRZ.CX)
stages.scope: Tiny circuits only: one controlled ZZ rotation in each form at a few non-special angles, alone and between one basis-change pair taken from the saved support metadata
stages.outputs: Compiled RZ/CX counts per unit; no price, no model fit
stages.decision: If confirmed, the user chooses (i) asking C for a separate structural quantity S' that counts the actual lowering, or (ii) a mechanism term in the residual model. If refuted, the residual is treated as compiler-context driven only

stages.reuses: C d458b5e4 option D: m0 (q1/R2) and m6 (q64/R128), normal n=2 paths per round, same-path X/Y
stages.change_proposed_by_D: S is taken on the same requests in the same call (no separate S run); records go through compiled_residual.paired_residuals with role DEVELOPMENT
stages.seeds: Fixed before execution with the C1 trial_seed scheme and a new cohort name; recorded in the plan
stages.cache: Existing fingerprint cache reused only after compiler/fingerprint binding checks
stages.measurements: Per-path C, S, D per axis, event digest, fingerprints, wall time and peak RSS of m6 compile
stages.not_claimed: No calibration, no all-law mean price, no precision guarantee (n=2), no rare order2 contribution

stages.preconditions: P1 complete; C K1 E[S] available (K0 PASS) for the rounds used, or the user accepts a finite-cohort S mean as a separate scenario
stages.far_holdout: m7 (q128/R255, 32640 event positions) only if the P1 m6 resource record makes it feasible
stages.sample_size_rule: Start n0=8 normal paths per round; then n = ceil((z * s_D / (eps_C * E[C]))^2) with z and eps_C fixed by the user/B before holdout prices are observed
stages.rare_order2: Separate forced-conditional stratum per round, weighted by the law probability of at least one order2 event; not pooled with normal paths
model_forms_allowed: On-path three-term form theta0 + theta_q q + theta_L qR restricted to R ~ 2q (identifiable with >=3 rounds; q and R not separable)
Mechanism form E[#controlled-ZZ rotations] * d_ZZ + q * d_outer + d_0, with E[#ZZ rotations] from the law (only if P0 confirms the mechanism)
stages.acceptance: Holdout tolerance and metric fixed before holdout data; calibration and holdout cohorts disjoint; X/Y paired, n counts paths

stages.only_if: The residual model must transfer to a kappa schedule other than the fixed S0 (R != ~2q)
stages.design: q-only and R-only points disjoint from P2, with fresh holdout

not_included: fit or adoption of a residual model
H6 or other rounds beyond the stages above
